title: Arlo - I Built an AI Companion That Gives Blind Users the Same 3-Second Superpower Sighted People Have

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Arlo gives blind users the same 3-second visual buffer sighted people take for granted — a game-changer for navigation and safety.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But "built" implies a one-size-fits-all solution. Arlo doesn't adapt to user behavior or environmental changes in real time.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Arlo uses real-time LiDAR and haptic feedback loops, updating every 0.5 seconds — far more responsive than any visual system.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: "Built" is vague. Arlo's success depends on third-party hardware, making it unreliable in low-resource or rural areas.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Arlo's open API allows integration with any device — that's not a weakness, that's flexibility.
